description: Deletes a custom dashboard or tombstones (marks as deleted) a pre-built dashboard within a Sentry organization.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for deleting an organization's dashboard.

dashboard_id.description: Numerical ID of the dashboard to delete.
dashboard_id.title: Dashboard Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: Identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: DeleteOrganizationDashboardRequest

name: delete_organization_dashboard

DeleteOrganizationDashboardResponse.description:
Response schema for successful dashboard deletion.

Returns HTTP 204 No Content on successful deletion, indicating the dashboard
was successfully deleted or tombstoned (for pre-built dashboards). No response
body is included.
DeleteOrganizationDashboardResponse.title: DeleteOrganizationDashboardResponse
